t1a.title: Water consumption in three cities

chart.title: Average daily water consumption per person in three cities, 1995-2020

t1a.prompt: The graph below shows the average amount of water used per person per day in three cities between 1995 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The line graph compares the average amount of water used per person each day in three cities, Northbridge, Ravenport and Calden, between 1995 and 2020.

Overall, consumption in Northbridge fell steadily, whereas it rose in the other two cities, with Calden showing by far the sharpest increase. As a result, the ranking of the three cities was completely reversed over the period.

At the start of the period, in 1995, a typical resident of Northbridge used 310 litres of water a day, considerably more than people in Ravenport (180 litres) and Calden (120 litres). Over the following 25 years, the Northbridge figure declined without interruption, dropping to 240 litres in 2010 and reaching a low of 190 litres in 2020.

By contrast, daily use in Ravenport grew gradually, from 195 litres in 2000 to 220 litres in 2010, before levelling off at 225 litres in 2015 and 230 litres in 2020. Calden recorded the most dramatic change, with consumption more than doubling. It climbed from 140 litres in 2000 to 205 litres in 2010 and then overtook both of the other cities, reaching 245 litres in 2015 and 260 litres by the end of the period, the highest daily figure recorded in any of the three cities.
t1a.overview: Overall, consumption in Northbridge fell steadily, whereas it rose in the other two cities, with Calden showing by far the sharpest increase.
t1a.notes: Mở bài: viết lại đề bằng từ khác (water used per person each day). Tổng quan: nêu 2 xu hướng ngược nhau (Northbridge giảm, hai thành phố còn lại tăng) và việc thứ hạng bị đảo ngược hoàn toàn, không đưa số liệu. Thân bài 1: Northbridge, đi từ số cao nhất năm 1995 (310) xuống 190. Thân bài 2: gộp Ravenport và Calden vì cùng tăng; nhấn mạnh Calden tăng hơn gấp đôi và vượt cả hai thành phố kia vào năm 2015. Không cần liệt kê mọi mốc năm, chỉ chọn điểm đầu, điểm cuối và điểm giao cắt.
phrases: giảm liên tục, không có lúc nào tăng lại
chạm mức thấp nhất là (dùng cho điểm cuối của xu hướng giảm)
chững lại, đi ngang ở mức
vượt qua (dùng khi hai đường cắt nhau)
thứ hạng bị đảo ngược hoàn toàn, câu hay cho phần tổng quan
by the end of the period
vào cuối giai đoạn, tránh lặp lại năm 2020
t1a.model9:
The line graph tracks average daily water use per person in three cities, Northbridge, Ravenport and Calden, over the 25 years from 1995.

The defining feature of the period is a complete reversal of the rankings. Northbridge, initially by far the thirstiest city, ended up as the most economical, while Calden climbed from the bottom to the top. Ravenport, whose consumption grew only modestly, stayed in the middle throughout.

In 1995, a Northbridge resident used 310 litres a day, more than two and a half times the figure for Calden (120 litres), with Ravenport in between at 180. Consumption in Northbridge then fell without a single interruption, shedding between 15 and 30 litres in every five-year interval, to finish at 190 litres, almost 40% below its starting point.

Calden moved in precisely the opposite direction, its figure more than doubling to 260 litres. The sharpest rise came between 2010 and 2015, when it jumped by 40 litres and overtook both of its neighbours. Ravenport's growth, in contrast, was gentle and tapered off over time: having risen by 40 litres in the first 15 years, it edged up by only 10 more to reach 230 litres in 2020. By the end of the period, therefore, a typical Calden resident was using 70 litres a day more than one in Northbridge.
why9: Overview built on one insight

Câu "The defining feature of the period is a complete reversal of the rankings" gói cả ba đường vào một nhận định duy nhất, rồi giải thích ngay ai lên ai xuống. Đây là tổng quan sắc nét mà giám khảo tìm cho TA band 9.
Ratio instead of raw numbers
"more than two and a half times the figure for Calden" biến hai con số 310 và 120 thành một phép so sánh có ý nghĩa (310/120 = 2,58). Đây là so sánh thật sự chứ không phải liệt kê (TA, LR).
Data compressed into a rate
"shedding between 15 and 30 litres in every five-year interval" tóm năm mốc năm của Northbridge vào một cụm, tránh kiểu "295 in 2000, 270 in 2005..." làm bài nặng số (TA).
Cohesion through reference, not linkers
"Calden moved in precisely the opposite direction" nối đoạn bằng ý nghĩa (ngược chiều với Northbridge) thay vì mở bằng "Moreover" hay "On the other hand" (CC).
Participle clause used for meaning
"having risen by 40 litres in the first 15 years, it edged up by only 10 more" dùng mệnh đề phân từ để đặt hai giai đoạn cạnh nhau, làm nổi bật việc tăng trưởng chậm lại (GRA).
Precise verbs of change
"tapered off" và "edged up" mô tả đúng mức độ thay đổi nhỏ dần, chính xác hơn "increased slightly" lặp đi lặp lại (LR).
Synthesising final comparison

"a typical Calden resident was using 70 litres a day more than one in Northbridge" khép bài bằng một phép trừ chéo (260 - 190) cho thấy hệ quả của sự đảo chiều, dùng "one" để tránh lặp "resident" (TA, LR).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 nêu đúng xu hướng nhưng liệt kê gần như mọi mốc năm và tổng quan chỉ nói "tăng" hay "giảm". Bài band 9 đặt ý chính là sự đảo ngược thứ hạng ngay trong tổng quan và chỉ ra Ravenport đứng giữa suốt giai đoạn. Số liệu được nén thành tỷ lệ (gấp 2,5 lần, giảm gần 40%) và tốc độ (15-30 lít mỗi 5 năm), nên bài ít số hơn mà nhiều thông tin hơn. Bài còn phát hiện chi tiết band 8 bỏ qua: Ravenport tăng chậm hẳn sau 2010 và Calden vượt cả hai thành phố trong cùng một khoảng 2010-2015.

t1a.title: Visitors to tourist attractions

chart.title: Number of visitors to three types of attraction in one country, 2008-2023

t1a.prompt: The graph below shows the number of visitors to three types of tourist attraction in one country between 2008 and 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The line graph illustrates how many people visited three kinds of tourist attraction in one country, namely museums, theme parks and national parks, from 2008 to 2023.

Overall, all three attractions became more popular in the long term, and museums received the most visitors in most years. The most striking feature is the sharp fall in visits to museums and theme parks in 2020, a year in which national parks continued to grow.

Museums received 12.4 million visitors in 2008, and this number rose steadily to 15.2 million in 2017. Theme parks followed a similar pattern, increasing from 8.5 million to 12.9 million over the same period. In 2020, however, both figures collapsed, to 6.3 million and 4.1 million respectively. Both types of attraction recovered quickly afterwards, however, with museums reaching 14.8 million in 2023 and theme parks a record 13.5 million.

National parks, by contrast, started from the lowest base of 5.2 million and grew slowly to 7.4 million in 2017. Their popularity then accelerated, and in 2020 they were the most visited attraction, with 9.0 million visitors. Growth continued over the next three years, and by 2023 the figure had more than doubled since 2008, reaching 10.7 million.
t1a.overview: Overall, all three attractions became more popular in the long term, and museums received the most visitors in most years.
t1a.notes: Tổng quan gồm 2 ý: xu hướng chung là tăng, và đặc điểm nổi bật nhất là cú sụt giảm năm 2020 của museums và theme parks. Thân bài 1: gộp museums và theme parks vì có cùng hình dạng (tăng đều, sụt mạnh năm 2020, phục hồi). Thân bài 2: national parks là ngoại lệ, tăng liên tục và trở thành điểm đến đông nhất năm 2020. Dùng 'respectively' để báo hai số trong một câu. Chú ý: museums năm 2023 (14.8) vẫn thấp hơn đỉnh 2017 (15.2), nên không viết là đạt kỷ lục.
phrases: cụ thể là, dùng để liệt kê ngay sau một danh từ chung
đặc điểm nổi bật nhất là
lần lượt (theo thứ tự đã nêu)
start from the lowest base of
xuất phát từ mức thấp nhất là
mức độ phổ biến tăng nhanh hơn
t1a.model9:
The line graph compares visitor numbers at museums, theme parks and national parks in one country at three-year intervals between 2008 and 2023.

Overall, all three types of attraction ended the period busier than they began it, but their paths diverged sharply in 2020. Museums and theme parks, which had grown in tandem, suffered a dramatic collapse that year before bouncing back, whereas national parks enjoyed uninterrupted growth and briefly became the most visited attraction.

Museums were the most popular attraction in every year except 2020, with visitor numbers rising steadily from 12.4 million in 2008 to 15.2 million in 2017, while theme parks grew somewhat faster, from 8.5 million to 12.9 million. In 2020, however, museum attendance more than halved to 6.3 million, and theme parks fared even worse, retaining less than a third of their visitors at 4.1 million. Both recovered swiftly, but only theme parks surpassed their earlier peak, reaching 13.5 million in 2023, whereas museums, at 14.8 million, remained slightly below theirs.

National parks, by contrast, started from the smallest base, attracting just 5.2 million people in 2008. Growth was gradual at first but gathered pace after 2014, and the figure kept climbing even in 2020, to 9.0 million. By 2023, it stood at 10.7 million, more than double its original level.
why9: Overview that isolates the turning point

"their paths diverged sharply in 2020" chỉ ra đúng thời điểm quan trọng nhất của biểu đồ, rồi câu sau giải thích hai nhóm đi theo hai hướng khác nhau. Tổng quan band 8 chỉ nói "all three became more popular" (TA).
Smart grouping

"Museums and theme parks, which had grown in tandem" gộp hai đường có cùng hình dạng thành một nhóm, để national parks làm ngoại lệ ở đoạn sau. Cụm "in tandem" (song song, cùng nhịp) là collocation tự nhiên (CC, LR).
Change expressed as proportion
"retaining less than a third of their visitors at 4.1 million" đúng số liệu (4,1/12,9 = 32%) và cho người đọc cảm nhận mức sụt giảm tốt hơn là chỉ đưa hai con số (TA).
Fine distinction a band 8 misses

"only theme parks surpassed their earlier peak ... whereas museums, at 14.8 million, remained slightly below theirs" so sánh mức phục hồi với đỉnh cũ (13,5 > 12,9 nhưng 14,8 < 15,2). Đây là quan sát tinh mà người chấm đánh giá cao (TA).
Accurate description of acceleration

"Growth was gradual at first but gathered pace after 2014" khớp với dữ liệu (chỉ tăng 0,4 và 0,5 triệu ở hai khoảng đầu, sau đó tăng 1,3 đến 1,7 triệu mỗi khoảng). "gather pace" là collocation tự nhiên (LR).
Varied, idiomatic verbs
"fared even worse", "bouncing back", "kept climbing" thay cho các động từ quen thuộc như "decreased" hay "recovered", vẫn giữ giọng học thuật (LR).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 mô tả đủ ý nhưng tổng quan còn chung chung và cách gộp nhóm chưa được gọi tên. Bài band 9 nêu rõ năm 2020 là điểm rẽ nhánh, gọi tên hai nhóm (cùng nhịp và ngoại lệ) ngay trong tổng quan. Bài dùng tỷ lệ (more than halved, less than a third) thay cho chỉ báo số, và so sánh mức phục hồi năm 2023 với đỉnh trước đó, một chi tiết band 8 chỉ nhắc thoáng qua. Từ vựng mô tả xu hướng đa dạng và chính xác hơn (fared even worse, gathered pace).

t1a.title: Sources of electricity

chart.title: Electricity generation by source in one country, 2000-2020

t1a.prompt: The graph below shows the percentage of electricity generated from different sources in one country between 2000 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The line graph shows the proportion of electricity produced from four sources, coal, gas, renewables and nuclear power, in one country between 2000 and 2020.

Overall, the country moved away from coal and towards renewable energy, which went from being a minor source to the largest one. Gas remained important throughout, while nuclear power made a small and stable contribution.

In 2000, coal was the dominant source, generating 58% of the country's electricity. Its share fell continuously throughout the following two decades, to 47% in 2008 and just 12% in 2020. Gas, which accounted for 30% at the start of the period, rose gradually to a peak of 38% in 2012, overtaking coal along the way, but it then slipped back to 31% by 2020.

Renewables showed the opposite trend to coal. Their share was only 7% in 2000 and increased slowly to 13% in 2008, after which growth accelerated markedly. They supplied 22% of electricity in 2012 and 38% in 2016, surpassing both fossil fuels, and by 2020 more than half of the country's power (52%) came from renewable sources. Nuclear power, meanwhile, fluctuated only slightly, between 4% and 5%, for the entire period.
t1a.overview: Overall, the country moved away from coal and towards renewable energy, which went from being a minor source to the largest one.
t1a.notes: Biểu đồ có 4 đường, nên phải gộp nhóm. Tổng quan: chuyển dịch từ than sang năng lượng tái tạo (hai đường ngược nhau), khí đốt giữ vai trò quan trọng, hạt nhân nhỏ và ổn định. Thân bài 1: hai nguồn hóa thạch (coal giảm liên tục, gas tăng đến đỉnh 2012 rồi giảm). Thân bài 2: renewables tăng tốc sau 2008, vượt cả coal và gas vào năm 2016, đạt 52%; nuclear chỉ cần một câu. Đơn vị là %, khi nói về mức thay đổi nên dùng 'percentage points'.
phrases: rise gradually to a peak of
có xu hướng ngược lại với
tốc độ tăng nhanh lên rõ rệt
t1a.model9:
The line graph shows how the share of a country's electricity supplied by coal, gas, renewables and nuclear power changed between 2000 and 2020.

The overriding trend is a near one-for-one substitution of renewables for coal: coal's share shrank by 46 percentage points while that of renewables grew by 45, turning a minor source into the dominant one. Gas and nuclear power, meanwhile, ended the period almost exactly where they began.

At the turn of the century, coal generated well over half of the country's electricity (58%), with renewables contributing a mere 7%. The decline of coal was modest at first but gathered momentum after 2004, and by 2020 its share had dwindled to just 12%. Renewables mirrored this pattern almost precisely, edging up to 13% by 2008 before surging to 38% in 2016 and 52% in 2020, by which point they supplied more than half of all power.

Gas played a steady supporting role. Its share rose from 30% to a peak of 38% in 2012, briefly making it the largest single source as coal fell away, before easing back to 31%, barely above its original level. Nuclear power was the only source that hardly changed at all, contributing between 4% and 5% throughout.
why9: Overview quantifies the key relationship

"a near one-for-one substitution of renewables for coal" kèm phép tính "shrank by 46 percentage points while that of renewables grew by 45" cho thấy người viết đã nhìn ra mối quan hệ giữa hai đường, không chỉ mô tả từng đường riêng (TA).
Correct unit for changes in percentages
"percentage points" được dùng đúng khi nói mức thay đổi của tỷ lệ phần trăm. Viết "fell by 46%" là sai bản chất số liệu (LR, TA).
Rate of change, not just direction
"modest at first but gathered momentum after 2004" mô tả tốc độ giảm của than (4, rồi 7, 12, 13 điểm mỗi giai đoạn) thay vì liệt kê các mốc (TA, LR).
Detail band 8 overlooks
"briefly making it the largest single source as coal fell away" chỉ ra năm 2012 khí đốt đứng đầu (38% so với 35% và 22%), một chi tiết đúng dữ liệu mà bài band 8 không nêu rõ (TA).
Efficient reference
"while that of renewables grew by 45" dùng "that of" thay cho "the share of", tránh lặp và rất tự nhiên trong văn học thuật (GRA, CC).
Precise contrastive verbs
"dwindled", "surging", "easing back" mỗi từ khớp với độ lớn của thay đổi: giảm dần còn ít, tăng vọt, giảm nhẹ trở lại (LR).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 nói than giảm và năng lượng tái tạo tăng, nhưng không lượng hóa mối quan hệ giữa hai đường. Bài band 9 chỉ ra hai con số gần như bằng nhau (-46 và +45 điểm phần trăm), biến tổng quan thành một nhận định có bằng chứng. Bài cũng phát hiện khí đốt từng đứng đầu năm 2012 và khép lại gần mức ban đầu, nên hai nguồn còn lại được gói gọn trong một câu tổng quan. Ngôn ngữ mô tả tốc độ (gathered momentum, surging) giúp bài ít số mà vẫn chính xác.

t1a.title: Leisure time by age group

chart.title: Average hours per week spent on leisure activities, by age group

t1a.prompt: The chart below shows the average number of hours per week that people in different age groups spend on four leisure activities. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The bar chart compares the average number of hours per week that people in four age groups spend on four leisure activities: using social media, watching television, doing sport or exercise, and reading.

Overall, time spent on social media and sport decreases with age, whereas television and reading become more popular as people get older. Television is the main pastime for every group except the youngest.

The 16-24 age group spends 14 hours a week on social media, the highest figure for that group. This falls to 9 hours for people aged 25 to 44, 5 hours for those aged 45 to 64 and only 2 hours for the over-65s. A similar but less pronounced decline can be seen for sport and exercise, which drops from 6 hours among the youngest group to 4 hours for 25-44-year-olds and then stays at 3 hours for the two oldest groups.

Television viewing follows the opposite pattern. Young people watch 8 hours a week, and the figure rises to 10 and 13 hours for the two middle groups, before jumping to 21 hours for those aged 65 and over, the highest figure in the chart. Reading is the least common pastime among the young, at just 2 hours, but the over-65s spend 8 hours a week on it.
t1a.overview: Overall, time spent on social media and sport decreases with age, whereas television and reading become more popular as people get older.
t1a.notes: Biểu đồ cột không có thời gian, nên dùng thì hiện tại đơn và so sánh giữa các nhóm tuổi. Cách gộp nhóm hiệu quả: các hoạt động giảm theo tuổi (social media, sport) ở thân bài 1, các hoạt động tăng theo tuổi (TV, reading) ở thân bài 2. Tổng quan nêu hai xu hướng ngược nhau và việc TV là hoạt động chính của mọi nhóm trừ nhóm 16-24. Nêu số cao nhất của cả biểu đồ (21 giờ xem TV của nhóm 65+).
phrases: những người từ 25 đến 44 tuổi (dùng như danh từ)
a similar but less pronounced decline
sự sụt giảm tương tự nhưng ít rõ rệt hơn
diễn biến theo chiều ngược lại
become more popular as people get older
trở nên phổ biến hơn khi người ta lớn tuổi hơn
t1a.model9:
The bar chart compares how many hours a week people in four age groups devote to social media, television, sport or exercise, and reading.

Overall, age divides these activities neatly into two pairs: social media and sport lose ground as people get older, while television and reading gain it. Television is the main pastime for everyone over 25, and its lead becomes overwhelming among the over-65s.

The youngest group stands apart in favouring social media over television. People aged 16 to 24 spend 14 hours a week online in this way, seven times as long as the over-65s, who log just 2 hours. Sport and exercise follow the same downward path, though far less steeply, falling from 6 hours among the young to a steady 3 hours for both groups over 45.

Television viewing, by contrast, rises with every age group, from 8 hours for 16-24-year-olds to 21 hours for those aged 65 and above, the single highest figure in the chart. Reading shows a similar progression on a smaller scale, quadrupling from 2 to 8 hours across the age range. Taken together, the four activities occupy the oldest group for 34 hours a week, compared with 26 hours for each of the two middle groups.
why9: Grouping stated in the overview
"age divides these activities neatly into two pairs" cho người đọc biết ngay cấu trúc bài: hai hoạt động giảm theo tuổi, hai hoạt động tăng theo tuổi. Đoạn thân bài theo đúng cấu trúc này (TA, CC).
Ratio comparisons
"seven times as long as the over-65s" (14/2) và "quadrupling from 2 to 8 hours" thay thế việc liệt kê từng nhóm tuổi, mà vẫn chính xác (TA).
Comparison of rates of change
"follow the same downward path, though far less steeply" so sánh không chỉ chiều mà cả độ dốc của hai xu hướng (TA, LR).
Extra insight from the data
"Taken together, the four activities occupy the oldest group for 34 hours a week" là phép cộng người viết tự làm (2+21+3+8), cho thấy khả năng khai thác dữ liệu vượt mức mô tả bề mặt (TA).
Natural phrasal and idiomatic verbs
"lose ground", "stands apart", "log just 2 hours" là cách nói tự nhiên của người bản ngữ có học, không phải cụm học thuộc (LR).
Correct tense for timeless data
Toàn bài dùng hiện tại đơn ("spend", "rises", "occupy") vì biểu đồ không có mốc thời gian, nhất quán từ đầu đến cuối (GRA).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 cũng gộp nhóm đúng nhưng đoạn thân bài liệt kê số của cả bốn nhóm tuổi cho social media. Bài band 9 thay chuỗi số đó bằng một tỷ lệ (gấp bảy lần) và so sánh độ dốc của hai xu hướng giảm. Tổng quan band 9 gọi tên cấu trúc "two pairs" nên bài mạch lạc hơn. Bài còn có một quan sát tổng hợp mà band 8 không có: nhóm lớn tuổi nhất dành nhiều giờ nhất cho bốn hoạt động cộng lại.

t1a.title: International students in five countries

chart.title: International students enrolled at universities, 2012 and 2022

t1a.prompt: The chart below shows the number of international students enrolled at universities in five countries in 2012 and 2022. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The bar chart compares the number of international students enrolled at universities in five countries in 2012 and 2022.

Overall, every country saw an increase in international enrolments over the decade, but the scale of growth varied greatly. Canada experienced by far the largest rise and replaced Australia as the most popular destination.

In 2012, Australia hosted the greatest number of overseas students, at 230,000, followed closely by Germany with 210,000. Japan and Canada, the two countries in the middle of the ranking, had similar numbers, at 135,000 and 120,000 respectively, while the Netherlands attracted only 60,000, the lowest figure on the chart.

Ten years later, the picture had changed considerably, and the order of the top three countries was different. Canada's figure more than tripled to 410,000, making it the leading host country. Germany also grew strongly to 365,000, moving into second place ahead of Australia, which rose by 100,000 to 330,000. Enrolments in the Netherlands more than doubled to 125,000, although the country remained at the bottom of the ranking. Japan recorded the smallest increase, from 135,000 to 180,000, and as a result it fell from third to fourth place.
t1a.overview: Overall, every country saw an increase in international enrolments over the decade, but the scale of growth varied greatly.
t1a.notes: Hai năm, năm nước: chia thân bài theo năm. Thân bài 1 mô tả thứ hạng năm 2012 (quá khứ đơn). Thân bài 2 mô tả năm 2022 kèm mức thay đổi (tripled, doubled, rose by) và sự thay đổi thứ hạng. Tổng quan: tất cả đều tăng nhưng mức tăng khác nhau, Canada tăng mạnh nhất và lên vị trí số 1. Đơn vị là nghìn sinh viên, nên viết 410,000 chứ không viết 410.

move into second place ahead of
vươn lên vị trí thứ hai, vượt qua
remain at the bottom of the ranking
vẫn đứng cuối bảng xếp hạng
the scale of growth varied greatly
mức độ tăng trưởng rất khác nhau
t1a.model9:
The bar chart compares the number of international students enrolled at universities in Canada, Germany, Japan, Australia and the Netherlands in 2012 and 2022.

Overall, international enrolments rose in all five countries, almost doubling in total from 755,000 to 1.41 million, but the gains were very unevenly distributed. Canada's expansion was in a league of its own, propelling it from fourth place to first.

In 2012, Australia and Germany were the clear leaders, hosting 230,000 and 210,000 overseas students respectively. Japan and Canada occupied the middle ground with broadly similar intakes of 135,000 and 120,000, while the Netherlands trailed well behind at 60,000.

Over the following decade, Canada's figure more than tripled to 410,000. Its increase of 290,000 students exceeded the gains made by Germany and Australia combined, even though both of those countries also grew substantially, to 365,000 and 330,000. As a result, Australia slipped from first to third place. The Netherlands achieved the second-highest growth rate, more than doubling its intake to 125,000, yet it remained at the bottom of the table. why9: Overview with a computed total
"almost doubling in total from 755,000 to 1.41 million" là con số người viết tự cộng, tạo bối cảnh chung trước khi nói về sự chênh lệch giữa các nước (TA).
Idiomatic emphasis
"in a league of its own" (vượt trội hẳn, không ai sánh được) là thành ngữ dùng tự nhiên, thay cho "increased the most" (LR).
Comparison across data points
"exceeded the gains made by Germany and Australia combined" đúng dữ liệu (290 nghìn so với 155 + 100 = 255 nghìn), một phép so sánh chéo cho thấy quy mô vượt trội của Canada (TA).
Distinguishing absolute and relative growth
"the second-highest growth rate" cho Hà Lan và "the weakest growth in both absolute and relative terms" cho Nhật phân biệt mức tăng tuyệt đối và tương đối. Đây là tư duy dữ liệu của band 9 (TA, LR).
Concessive linking
"even though both of those countries also grew substantially" và "yet it remained at the bottom of the table" dùng quan hệ nhượng bộ để giữ cân bằng thông tin, không phải từ nối máy móc (CC, GRA).
Consequences of change shown through ranking
"slipped from first to third place", "dropped from third to fourth" nói về thứ hạng, giúp người đọc thấy hệ quả của các con số (TA, LR).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 mô tả đúng nhưng tổng quan chưa có con số định hướng và thân bài chủ yếu nêu từng nước một. Bài band 9 thêm tổng số hai năm để cho thấy toàn cảnh, rồi dùng so sánh chéo (Canada tăng nhiều hơn Đức và Úc cộng lại). Bài phân biệt tăng tuyệt đối và tăng tương đối, nhờ đó nhận xét về Hà Lan và Nhật chính xác hơn. Cấu trúc nhượng bộ (even though, yet) giúp câu dài mà vẫn rõ ràng.

t1a.title: Seasonal sales at seaside cafés

chart.title: Sales of three products at a chain of seaside cafés, by season

t1a.prompt: The chart below shows the sales of three products at a chain of seaside cafés in each season of one year. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The bar chart shows the number of ice creams, hot drinks and umbrellas sold by a chain of seaside cafés in each of the four seasons.

Overall, sales of ice cream and hot drinks moved in opposite directions across the year, with ice cream peaking in summer and hot drinks in winter. Umbrella sales were very small by comparison and were highest in autumn.

Ice cream was the best-selling product in summer, when 96,000 units were sold, four times the number of hot drinks sold in the same season (24,000). In spring, by contrast, hot drinks were slightly more popular, at 55,000 compared with 42,000 ice creams. As the weather cooled, ice cream sales fell sharply to 30,000 in autumn and just 8,000 in winter.

Hot drinks showed the reverse pattern. After their summer low, sales rose to 68,000 in autumn and reached 110,000 in winter, the highest figure for any product in any season. Umbrellas sold in much smaller quantities throughout the year. Only 1,200 were bought in summer, compared with 3,500 in spring, but the figure climbed to 6,800 in autumn before falling slightly to 5,400 in winter.
t1a.overview: Overall, sales of ice cream and hot drinks moved in opposite directions across the year, with ice cream peaking in summer and hot drinks in winter.
t1a.notes: Tổng quan: kem và đồ uống nóng diễn biến ngược nhau, ô bán rất ít và cao nhất vào mùa thu. Thân bài 1: kem (đỉnh mùa hè, so sánh trực tiếp với đồ uống nóng cùng mùa). Thân bài 2: đồ uống nóng (đỉnh mùa đông, cũng là số cao nhất toàn biểu đồ) và ô. Đơn vị là nghìn sản phẩm, nên 3.5 phải viết là 3,500. Không đoán nguyên nhân (ví dụ mùa thu mưa nhiều) vì biểu đồ không cho thông tin đó.
phrases: diễn biến theo hai chiều ngược nhau
sau mức thấp nhất vào mùa hè
the highest figure for any product in any season
số cao nhất của mọi sản phẩm trong mọi mùa
t1a.model9:
The bar chart shows how many ice creams, hot drinks and umbrellas a chain of seaside cafés sold in each season of one year.

Overall, sales of the two refreshment products were strongly seasonal and moved in opposite directions, with ice cream peaking in summer and hot drinks in winter. Umbrellas, sold in far smaller numbers, followed a pattern of their own, peaking in autumn.

Summer was the only season in which ice cream outsold hot drinks, and it did so by a wide margin: 96,000 units against 24,000, a ratio of four to one. Outside the summer months, demand for ice cream fell away sharply, from 42,000 in spring and 30,000 in autumn to a mere 8,000 in winter, just one-twelfth of its peak.

Hot drinks followed the reverse trajectory. From their summer low, sales almost tripled to 68,000 in autumn and then climbed to 110,000 in winter, the highest figure for any product in any season. Umbrella sales, though only in the low thousands, were also weakest in summer, at just 1,200. why9: Overview grouping by behaviour
"moved in opposite directions, with ice cream peaking in summer and hot drinks in winter" nêu cả hai đỉnh trong một câu, và "followed a pattern of their own" tách ô ra làm nhóm riêng (TA, CC).
Comparison framed as an exception

"Summer was the only season in which ice cream outsold hot drinks" là phát hiện chỉ có được khi so sánh hai sản phẩm qua cả bốn mùa (42<55, 30<68, 8<110). Một câu thay cho bốn phép so sánh riêng lẻ (TA).
Ratios and fractions
"a ratio of four to one", "just one-twelfth of its peak", "more than five times higher" đều khớp dữ liệu (96/24, 8/96, 6,8/1,2) và làm bài đa dạng cách biểu đạt số (TA, LR).
Correct conversion of units
"96,000 units", "1,200", "6,800": đơn vị của biểu đồ là nghìn, nên 1.2 phải viết thành 1,200. Sai bước này là lỗi TA nặng.
Hedged scale description
"though only in the low thousands" đặt số liệu của ô vào đúng quy mô so với hai sản phẩm kia, không cần thêm câu so sánh dài (LR, CC).
Precise verbs
"fell away sharply", "followed the reverse trajectory", "easing slightly" mỗi cụm khớp với mức thay đổi thực tế (LR).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 có tổng quan tốt nhưng thân bài mô tả kem và đồ uống nóng như hai câu chuyện riêng. Bài band 9 so sánh trực tiếp hai sản phẩm qua cả năm và rút ra nhận định "mùa hè là mùa duy nhất kem bán chạy hơn". Số liệu được biến thành tỷ lệ và phân số (4:1, một phần mười hai, gấp hơn năm lần), nên đoạn văn có tính phân tích hơn. Từ vựng xu hướng cũng phong phú và chính xác hơn.

t1a.title: Household spending

chart.title: Average household spending in one country, 1990 and 2020

t1a.prompt: The pie charts below show how the average household in one country spent its money in 1990 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The pie charts compare how the average household in one country divided its spending among six categories in 1990 and 2020.

Overall, housing replaced food as the largest area of expenditure, and leisure became considerably more important, while the share spent on clothing fell markedly.

In 1990, food took the biggest proportion of household budgets, at 31%, followed by housing at 22%. Clothing accounted for 14%, while transport and the "other" category each made up 12%. Leisure was the smallest category of all, representing just 9% of total household spending.

Thirty years later, the pattern of spending had shifted noticeably, with some categories growing and others shrinking. The share devoted to housing rose by 12 percentage points to 34%, making it by far the largest expense. Spending on food, in contrast, almost halved, falling to 17%. Leisure also grew significantly, from 9% to 16%, so that it was almost level with food. Transport increased modestly to 15%, whereas clothing dropped from 14% to only 6%, becoming the smallest category. The proportion spent on other items was the only one that remained unchanged, at 12% in both years.
t1a.overview: Overall, housing replaced food as the largest area of expenditure, and leisure became considerably more important, while the share spent on clothing fell markedly.
t1a.notes: Hai biểu đồ tròn ở hai năm: thân bài 1 mô tả cơ cấu năm 1990 theo thứ tự lớn đến nhỏ, thân bài 2 mô tả năm 2020 và mức thay đổi. Tổng quan nêu thay đổi lớn nhất: housing thay food ở vị trí số 1, leisure tăng, clothing giảm. Với số %, khi nói mức tăng giảm dùng 'percentage points' (22% lên 34% là tăng 12 percentage points, không phải 12%). Thay đổi cách diễn đạt: took, accounted for, made up, represented, the share devoted to.
phrases: chiếm tỷ lệ lớn nhất trong
chiếm (dùng luân phiên để tránh lặp)
t1a.model9:
The pie charts compare how the average household in one country divided its spending among six categories in 1990 and 2020.

Overall, the balance of household budgets shifted decisively from food towards housing, which became the largest expense. Tellingly, though, these two essentials together absorbed roughly half of all spending in both years, so what changed was their relative weight rather than their combined burden. Leisure and clothing, meanwhile, effectively swapped places in the ranking.

In 1990, food was the single biggest item, accounting for almost a third of spending (31%), with housing a clear second at 22%. Clothing took 14%, transport and other items 12% each, and leisure just 9%, the smallest share of all.

By 2020, housing had risen by 12 percentage points to 34%, double the share now devoted to food, which had fallen to 17%. Leisure was the main beneficiary elsewhere, its share climbing from 9% to 16% and lifting it from last place to third, just one point behind food. Clothing moved in the opposite direction, its share more than halving to only 6%, which made it the least significant category. Transport edged up to 15%, while the proportion spent on other items was the only one to remain unchanged, at 12%.
why9: Insight beyond the obvious

"these two essentials together absorbed roughly half of all spending in both years" là phép cộng tự làm (22+31 = 53, 34+17 = 51), cho thấy thay đổi nằm ở tỷ trọng giữa hai khoản chứ không phải gánh nặng tổng. Đây là kiểu tổng quan bài band 8 không có (TA).
Stance word used precisely
"Tellingly" (điều đáng chú ý, nói lên nhiều điều) báo hiệu nhận định sâu hơn mà không cần câu dài, dùng tự nhiên chứ không phô diễn (LR, CC).
Ranking changes summarised
"effectively swapped places in the ranking" gói sự thay đổi của leisure (cuối lên thứ ba) và clothing (thứ ba xuống cuối) trong một cụm (TA).
Relational comparison
"double the share now devoted to food" so sánh hai khoản trong cùng năm 2020 (34 = 2 x 17), thay vì báo hai con số riêng (TA).
Percentage points used correctly
"risen by 12 percentage points to 34%" dùng đúng đơn vị cho mức thay đổi của tỷ lệ (LR).
Absolute phrases for compact detail
"its share climbing from 9% to 16% and lifting it from last place to third" dùng cấu trúc tuyệt đối (danh từ + V-ing) để thêm thông tin mà không cần câu mới (GRA).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 nêu đúng ba thay đổi lớn nhưng chỉ dừng ở mức mô tả. Bài band 9 thêm một nhận định có tính phân tích: nhà ở và thực phẩm cộng lại vẫn khoảng một nửa chi tiêu, chỉ đổi tỷ trọng cho nhau. Bài còn dùng so sánh trong cùng năm (nhà ở gấp đôi thực phẩm) và thứ hạng (leisure từ cuối lên thứ ba). Ngữ pháp đa dạng một cách có mục đích, như cấu trúc tuyệt đối "its share climbing...", giúp câu gọn mà giàu thông tin.

t1a.title: What happens to a city's waste

chart.title: Destination of municipal waste in one city, 2005 and 2025

t1a.prompt: The pie charts below show how the municipal waste in one city was dealt with in 2005 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The two pie charts show what happened to the municipal waste produced in a city in 2005 and 2025.

Overall, the city became far less dependent on landfill over the 20-year period. In 2005 most rubbish was buried, but by 2025 recycling had become the most common method of disposal, and every alternative to landfill had grown in importance.

In 2005, almost two-thirds of the city's waste (64%) was sent to landfill sites. Recycling was a distant second, accounting for 18%, while 11% was burned in incinerators that generated energy. Composting dealt with only a small fraction of the waste, just 5%, and the remaining 2% was handled in other ways.

By 2025, the proportion going to landfill had plummeted to 21%, roughly a third of its earlier level. Recycling, on the other hand, more than doubled to 41%, making it the main destination for the city's rubbish. Incineration with energy recovery also doubled, rising to 22%, so that slightly more waste was burned than buried. Composting nearly tripled, increasing from 5% to 14%. Finally, the small share of waste classified as other stayed exactly the same, at 2% in both years.
t1a.overview: Overall, the city became far less dependent on landfill over the 20-year period.
t1a.notes: Tổng quan: thành phố giảm phụ thuộc vào chôn lấp, tái chế trở thành phương thức chính, mọi phương án thay thế đều tăng. Thân bài 1: năm 2005, dùng câu bị động (was sent, was burned) vì nói về rác. Thân bài 2: năm 2025 với các từ chỉ mức thay đổi (plummeted, more than doubled, nearly tripled). Có thể dùng phân số thay cho % để đa dạng (64% = almost two-thirds, 21% = roughly a third of 64%). So sánh chéo: năm 2025 rác đốt (22%) nhiều hơn rác chôn (21%).
phrases: đứng thứ hai nhưng cách xa vị trí số một
roughly a third of its earlier level
khoảng một phần ba so với mức trước đó
t1a.model9:
The pie charts illustrate how a city disposed of its municipal waste in 2005 and 2025.

Overall, the city underwent a fundamental shift away from burying its rubbish. Landfill, which handled most of the waste in 2005, became a minority option by 2025, and every alternative grew in importance, with recycling emerging as the principal method.

In 2005, almost two-thirds of all waste (64%) went to landfill, more than three times the share that was recycled (18%). Incineration with energy recovery accounted for 11%, composting for a mere 5%, and the remaining 2% was dealt with by other means.

Twenty years later, the picture was transformed. The proportion sent to landfill had plummeted by 43 percentage points to 21%, roughly a third of its former level. The whole of this shortfall was absorbed by the other three main methods: recycling more than doubled to 41%, incineration doubled to 22%, and composting nearly tripled to 14%. Notably, the city was by then burning marginally more waste than it buried, while the share recycled was almost twice that sent to landfill. The small residual category was the only one to stay constant, at 2% in both years.
why9: Overview with a clear verdict

"underwent a fundamental shift away from burying its rubbish" là nhận định tổng thể, câu sau giải thích bằng ba ý (landfill thành thiểu số, mọi phương án khác tăng, tái chế thành phương thức chính) mà không có con số nào (TA).
Showing where the change went

"The whole of this shortfall was absorbed by the other three main methods" giải thích 43 điểm phần trăm mất đi đã chuyển sang đâu (23 + 11 + 9 = 43). Đây là cách nhóm dữ liệu theo quan hệ nhân quả trong số liệu, không phải liệt kê (TA, CC).
Colon to introduce grouped detail
Dấu hai chấm trước "recycling more than doubled to 41%, incineration doubled to 22%, and composting nearly tripled to 14%" gom ba thay đổi vào một câu song song, gọn và dễ đọc (GRA, CC).
Cross-category comparison
"burning marginally more waste than it buried" (22% so với 21%) và "almost twice that sent to landfill" (41 so với 21) so sánh chéo giữa các phương thức trong cùng năm (TA).
Fractions and multiples
"almost two-thirds", "more than three times the share", "roughly a third of its former level" đúng dữ liệu (64%, 64/18, 21/64) và tránh lặp ký hiệu % (LR).
Natural reference for repetition
"that sent to landfill" và "The small residual category" thay thế danh từ đã nêu, giữ văn trôi chảy (CC).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 đã có tổng quan tốt và dùng phân số, nhưng thân bài vẫn đi lần lượt từng phương thức. Bài band 9 chỉ ra mức giảm 43 điểm của landfill được ba phương thức kia hấp thụ gần như toàn bộ, một nhận định gắn các con số với nhau. Bài thêm hai phép so sánh chéo trong năm 2025 (đốt nhiều hơn chôn, tái chế gần gấp đôi chôn). Câu văn ngắn gọn hơn nhờ dấu hai chấm và cấu trúc song song.

t1a.title: Public transport in four cities

chart.title: Annual passenger journeys on public transport in four cities, 2023

t1a.prompt: The table below shows the number of passenger journeys made on three types of public transport in four cities in 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The table gives information about the number of passenger journeys made by bus, metro and tram in four cities, Arlon, Bressen, Coraval and Dunmere, in 2023.

Overall, Arlon had by far the busiest public transport system, while Bressen and Dunmere had the smallest. In three of the four cities, either the metro or the bus network was the most heavily used mode.

Arlon recorded a total of 750 million journeys, more than twice the figures for Bressen (335 million) and Dunmere (330 million). The majority of these journeys, 480 million, were made on the metro, while buses accounted for 210 million and trams for only 60 million. Coraval had the second highest total, at 580 million, and it was the city with the heaviest bus use, at 320 million journeys. Its metro carried 260 million passengers, but the city had no tram network.

The two smaller systems differed considerably. Bressen, which had no metro, relied mainly on trams, which carried 190 million passengers, the highest tram figure in the table, with the remaining 145 million journeys made by bus. In Dunmere, by contrast, the metro was the most popular option, with 150 million journeys, compared with 95 million by bus and 85 million by tram.
t1a.overview: Overall, Arlon had by far the busiest public transport system, while Bressen and Dunmere had the smallest.
t1a.notes: Bảng có nhiều số, không cần nêu hết. Tổng quan dựa vào cột Total (Arlon lớn nhất, Bressen và Dunmere nhỏ nhất) và phương tiện chính của mỗi thành phố. Gộp nhóm theo quy mô: thân bài 1 là hai hệ thống lớn (Arlon, Coraval), thân bài 2 là hai hệ thống nhỏ (Bressen, Dunmere). Số 0 trong bảng nghĩa là thành phố không có loại phương tiện đó, nên viết 'had no metro' thay vì '0 journeys'. Năm 2023 đã qua nên dùng quá khứ đơn.
phrases: đông đúc nhất, bỏ xa các thành phố khác
phương tiện được sử dụng nhiều nhất
more than twice the figures for
hơn gấp đôi số liệu của
phần lớn các chuyến đi này
t1a.model9:
The table shows the number of journeys made by bus, metro and tram in four cities, Arlon, Bressen, Coraval and Dunmere, in 2023.

Overall, the four networks fell into two clear tiers: Arlon and Coraval each handled more than half a billion journeys, whereas Bressen and Dunmere managed only around a third of a billion. Each city also had a distinct backbone, with no single mode of transport dominating everywhere.

Arlon had by far the busiest system, with 750 million journeys, nearly two-thirds of which (480 million) were made by metro, the highest figure for any mode in any city. Buses and trams played a secondary role there, carrying 210 million and 60 million passengers respectively. Coraval, the other large network at 580 million, depended instead on buses, which accounted for 320 million journeys, with the metro handling 260 million and no tram service at all.

Bressen and Dunmere had almost identical totals of 335 million and 330 million, but very different structures. Bressen, which lacked a metro, relied primarily on trams, whose 190 million journeys were the most of any tram network. Dunmere, by contrast, had the most balanced system of the four: its metro carried 150 million passengers, while buses and trams were close behind at 95 million and 85 million.
why9: Overview built on tiers
"fell into two clear tiers" và cách diễn đạt "more than half a billion" / "around a third of a billion" khái quát cột Total mà không đưa con số cụ thể, đúng tinh thần tổng quan (TA, LR).
Second overview point that organises the body
"Each city also had a distinct backbone, with no single mode of transport dominating everywhere" chuẩn bị cho thân bài, nơi mỗi thành phố được mô tả qua phương tiện chủ lực (CC).
Proportion within a total
"nearly two-thirds of which (480 million) were made by metro" (480/750 = 64%) dùng mệnh đề quan hệ với "of which" để nêu tỷ trọng, không chỉ nêu số (GRA, TA).
Handling zeros naturally
"no tram service at all" và "which lacked a metro" diễn đạt số 0 trong bảng bằng ngôn ngữ tự nhiên thay vì viết "0 journeys" (LR).
Contrast within a similar pair
"almost identical totals ... but very different structures" nêu điểm giống và khác của Bressen và Dunmere trong một câu, tạo lý do cho việc gộp hai thành phố (TA, CC).
Original analytical judgement
"the most balanced system of the four" là nhận định người viết rút ra (150, 95, 85 chênh nhau ít nhất), không có sẵn trong bảng (TA).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 cũng gộp theo quy mô, nhưng tổng quan thứ hai ("metro hoặc bus là phương tiện chính") còn mơ hồ. Bài band 9 gọi tên hai tầng quy mô và ý "mỗi thành phố có xương sống riêng", từ đó mỗi đoạn có một ý điều khiển rõ ràng. Bài nêu tỷ trọng (gần hai phần ba) và đưa ra nhận định phân tích như "hệ thống cân bằng nhất". Mệnh đề quan hệ "of which", "whose" làm câu chặt chẽ mà không gượng.

t1a.title: Physical activity by age and sex

chart.title: Adults meeting recommended physical activity levels, by age and sex, 2004 and 2024

t1a.prompt: The table below shows the percentage of men and women in different age groups who met the recommended level of physical activity in 2004 and 2024. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The table shows the percentage of men and women in four age groups who met the recommended level of physical activity in 2004 and 2024.

Overall, the proportion of adults meeting the guidelines increased in every category, and activity levels declined with age for both sexes. Although men were more active than women in both years, the gap between them narrowed considerably.

In 2004, just over half of men aged 18 to 34 (52%) were sufficiently active, compared with 38% of women in the same age group. The figures fell steadily with age, and among people aged 75 and over, only 14% of men and 9% of women met the recommended level.

By 2024, women had made much greater progress than men. The figure for young women rose by 17 percentage points to 55%, only slightly below that for young men, which had increased to 58%. Similar improvements were seen among women aged 35 to 54 and 55 to 74, whose rates climbed to 47% and 40%, compared with 49% and 42% for men. The oldest age group also improved notably: the proportion of active men rose from 14% to 25%, and that of women more than doubled to 21%.
t1a.overview: Overall, the proportion of adults meeting the guidelines increased in every category, and activity levels declined with age for both sexes.
t1a.notes: Bảng có ba biến (tuổi, giới tính, năm), nên tổng quan cần ba ý: tất cả đều tăng, càng lớn tuổi càng ít vận động, khoảng cách nam nữ thu hẹp. Thân bài 1: năm 2004, so sánh nam và nữ ở nhóm trẻ nhất và nhóm già nhất. Thân bài 2: năm 2024, tập trung vào việc nữ giới tiến bộ nhanh hơn. Dùng 'percentage points' khi nói mức tăng của tỷ lệ phần trăm. Có thể gộp hai nhóm tuổi giữa trong một câu bằng 'respectively' hoặc 'compared with'.
phrases: khoảng cách thu hẹp đáng kể
chỉ thấp hơn một chút so với số liệu của
t1a.model9:
The table compares the proportion of men and women in four age groups who met the recommended level of physical activity in 2004 and 2024.

Overall, activity rates rose across the board, yet two patterns held firm in both years: participation fell with age, and men were more active than women in every age group. What changed most was the size of that gender gap, which shrank dramatically as women's rates improved far faster than men's.

In 2004, the gap was considerable. Among 18-to-34-year-olds, just over half of men (52%) were sufficiently active, compared with only 38% of women, a difference of 14 points. Participation then declined steadily with age for both sexes, bottoming out at 14% of men and a mere 9% of women aged 75 and over.

Two decades later, every figure had increased, but women's gains, ranging from 12 to 17 percentage points, consistently outstripped those of men, which ranged from 6 to 12. As a result, the gap in each age group had narrowed to no more than four points; among young adults, for example, it was just three points, with 58% of men meeting the guidelines against 55% of women. The most striking relative improvement occurred among the oldest women, whose rate more than doubled to 21%, while that of men aged 75 and over rose to 25%.
why9: Overview handling three variables

Tổng quan nêu đủ ba chiều của bảng: tăng theo thời gian ("rose across the board"), giảm theo tuổi ("participation fell with age") và chênh lệch giới tính ("men were more active than women in every age group"). Câu "What changed most was the size of that gender gap" là câu chẻ dùng để nhấn mạnh ý chính (TA, GRA).
Ranges instead of listing
"women's gains, ranging from 12 to 17 percentage points ... those of men, which ranged from 6 to 12" tóm tám phép trừ vào một câu, đúng dữ liệu (nữ: 17, 14, 15, 12; nam: 6, 8, 12, 11) (TA).
Quantified gap
"narrowed to no more than four points" đúng với cả bốn nhóm tuổi năm 2024 (3, 2, 2, 4). Đây là kiểu khái quát có kiểm chứng mà giám khảo đánh giá cao (TA).
Absolute vs relative improvement

"The most striking relative improvement occurred among the oldest women" phân biệt mức tăng tương đối (9 lên 21, hơn gấp đôi) với mức tăng tuyệt đối, chính xác hơn việc nói "tăng nhiều nhất" (TA, LR).
Precise collocations
"held firm", "bottoming out at", "outstripped" là những động từ chính xác, tự nhiên trong văn học thuật (LR).
Exemplification without listing
"among young adults, for example, it was just three points" chọn một ví dụ minh họa cho khái quát vừa nêu thay vì liệt kê cả bốn nhóm (CC, TA).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 có tổng quan đúng nhưng ý về khoảng cách giới tính bị đặt sau và chưa được lượng hóa. Bài band 9 đưa khoảng cách giới tính lên làm thay đổi trung tâm, sau đó chứng minh bằng hai khoảng mức tăng (12-17 điểm so với 6-12 điểm) và kết luận khoảng cách còn tối đa bốn điểm. Cách tóm số theo khoảng và chọn một ví dụ minh họa giúp bài không bị nặng số. Câu chẻ "What changed most was..." nhấn mạnh đúng chỗ.

t1a.title: How black tea is produced

chart.title: The production of black tea
steps: Picking: the top two leaves and a bud are picked by hand from each tea bush
Collection: leaves are carried to the factory in baskets and weighed
Withering: leaves are spread on racks and exposed to warm air for 12-18 hours (about 60% of moisture lost)
Rolling: machines roll the leaves, breaking the cell walls and releasing natural juices
Oxidation: leaves are left in a humid room for 1-3 hours and turn from green to copper brown
Drying: hot-air dryers at around 100°C for 20 minutes
Sorting: vibrating sieves separate the tea into different leaf sizes
Grading: professional tasters grade each batch
Packing: tea is packed into foil-lined sacks or tea bags
Distribution: packed tea is shipped to wholesalers and shops

t1a.prompt: The diagram below shows how black tea is produced. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The diagram illustrates the stages involved in producing black tea, from picking the fresh leaves to delivering the finished product to shops.

Overall, the process consists of ten stages, beginning in the tea fields and ending with distribution. Most of the steps take place in a factory, where the leaves are withered, rolled, oxidised and dried before being sorted, graded and packed.

First, the top two leaves and a bud are picked by hand from each tea bush. These leaves are carried in baskets to the factory, where they are weighed. They are then spread out on racks and exposed to warm air for 12 to 18 hours and lose about 60% of their moisture. Next, the withered leaves are rolled by machine, which breaks their cell walls and releases their natural juices.

After rolling, the leaves are left in a humid room for one to three hours to oxidise, and their colour changes from green to copper brown. They are subsequently dried in hot-air dryers at around 100°C for 20 minutes. The dried tea is passed through vibrating sieves to separate it into different leaf sizes, and each batch is graded by tasters. Finally, the tea is packed and shipped to wholesalers and shops.
t1a.overview: Overall, the process consists of ten stages, beginning in the tea fields and ending with distribution.
t1a.notes: Quy trình dùng thì hiện tại đơn và chủ yếu là câu bị động (are picked, are weighed, is graded). Tổng quan: số bước, điểm bắt đầu và kết thúc, nơi diễn ra phần lớn quy trình. Chia thân bài làm hai nửa: thân bài 1 từ hái lá đến cán (bước 1-4), thân bài 2 từ oxy hóa đến phân phối (bước 5-10). Dùng từ nối thứ tự đa dạng: First, then, Next, After rolling, subsequently, Finally. Giữ nguyên các thông số trong sơ đồ (12-18 giờ, 60%, 100°C, 20 phút).
phrases: the process consists of ten stages
quy trình gồm mười giai đoạn
bắt đầu bằng ... và kết thúc bằng ...
sau khi cán (after + V-ing để nối bước)
t1a.model9:
The diagram outlines the ten stages by which fresh tea leaves become black tea ready for sale.

Overall, the process is largely linear and divides naturally into three phases: harvesting by hand in the fields, a sequence of physical and chemical transformations in the factory, and finally sorting, quality control and dispatch. The most time-consuming stage by far is withering, which takes up to 18 hours.

On the plantation, only the top two leaves and a bud are plucked from each bush. These are carried to the factory in baskets and weighed. They are then spread out on racks and exposed to warm air for 12 to 18 hours, during which time they lose around 60% of their moisture.

Once withered, the leaves are rolled by machine, a step that ruptures their cell walls and releases their natural juices. They are then left to oxidise in a humid room for one to three hours, gradually turning from green to copper brown. The oxidised leaves are dried in hot air at about 100°C for 20 minutes. Finally, the finished tea is sorted by leaf size using vibrating sieves, graded batch by batch by professional tasters, packed into foil-lined sacks or tea bags, and shipped to wholesalers and retailers.
why9: Overview that structures the process
"divides naturally into three phases" gom mười bước thành ba giai đoạn có tên gọi rõ ràng, giúp người đọc nắm cấu trúc trước khi vào chi tiết. Bài band 8 chỉ nói "consists of ten stages" (TA, CC).
Salient feature in the overview
"The most time-consuming stage by far is withering, which takes up to 18 hours" là đặc điểm nổi bật có so sánh, đúng yêu cầu "selecting the main features" (TA).
Cause and effect within the process
"a step that ruptures their cell walls and releases their natural juices" cho thấy mỗi bước tác động lên lá thế nào, không chỉ nêu thứ tự. "a step that..." là cụm đồng vị rất tự nhiên (CC, GRA).
Sequencing without mechanical linkers
"Once withered", "The oxidised leaves", "the finished tea" dùng chính trạng thái của lá để đánh dấu bước tiếp theo thay cho chuỗi "First, Then, Next" (CC, LR).
Passive used appropriately
"are plucked", "are carried", "are dried" dùng bị động vì người đọc quan tâm đến lá trà chứ không phải người làm, đúng văn phong mô tả quy trình (GRA).
Compact list of final steps
Câu cuối gom bốn bước cuối bằng chuỗi động từ song song "sorted ... graded ... packed ... and shipped", gọn mà không bỏ sót bước nào (GRA, TA).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 mô tả đúng mười bước theo thứ tự nhưng tổng quan chỉ đếm số bước và nói phần lớn diễn ra trong nhà máy. Bài band 9 chia quy trình thành ba giai đoạn có tên và nêu bước tốn thời gian nhất, nên tổng quan có thông tin thật sự. Thân bài nối các bước bằng quan hệ nguyên nhân kết quả và trạng thái của lá (once withered, the oxidised leaves) thay vì từ nối thứ tự. Mọi thông số (12-18 giờ, 60%, 100°C, 20 phút) vẫn được giữ chính xác.

One road bridge across the river in the centre of the village
Small fishing harbour on the east bank
Row of 12 houses along Main Road, south of the river
Railway line along the southern edge, with no station
Housing estate of about 200 homes on the former farmland north of the river

t1a.prompt: The maps below show the village of Ashford in 1995 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
t1a.model:
The maps illustrate the changes that took place in the riverside village of Ashford between 1995 and 2025.

Overall, Ashford developed from a small rural settlement into a larger, better-connected community. The most significant changes were a large housing estate, a railway station and a new marina, although several original features were retained.

In 1995, the land north of the river was used entirely for farming. By 2025, this farmland had been replaced by a housing estate of about 200 homes. A footbridge was built across the river to the east of the original road bridge, which was kept. On the east bank, the small fishing harbour was converted into a marina with a café.

South of the river, the row of 12 houses along Main Road remained unchanged, but the primary school was extended and a sports field was added behind it. The eastern half of the forest in the south-west corner made way for a car park, while the western half was preserved. Finally, although a railway line already ran along the southern edge of the village in 1995, there was no station until a new one was built next to the car park, with a supermarket opposite.
t1a.overview: Overall, Ashford developed from a small rural settlement into a larger, better-connected community.
t1a.notes: Bản đồ so sánh: dùng quá khứ đơn bị động và quá khứ hoàn thành (had been replaced) vì có mốc 'By 2025'. Tổng quan: xu hướng chung (từ làng nông thôn thành khu dân cư lớn hơn, giao thông tốt hơn) và 2-3 thay đổi lớn nhất. Chia thân bài theo vị trí: phía bắc sông và bờ sông ở thân bài 1, phía nam sông ở thân bài 2. Nhắc cả những gì giữ nguyên (cầu cũ, dãy 12 nhà, nửa khu rừng). Dùng từ chỉ phương hướng: north of, on the east bank, in the south-west corner, opposite.
phrases: bị dỡ bỏ để nhường chỗ cho
ở phía đông của / đối diện
t1a.model9:
The maps show how the riverside village of Ashford changed between 1995 and 2025.

Overall, Ashford was transformed from a quiet farming village into a sizeable, well-connected settlement. The most dramatic changes were the residential development north of the river and a new transport hub in the south, although the historic core along Main Road survived largely intact.

The greatest change occurred north of the river, where the farmland that once covered the entire area gave way to an estate of around 200 homes. A footbridge was added to the east of the original road bridge, which was retained. Further along the east bank, the small fishing harbour was redeveloped as a marina with a café, suggesting a shift from working waterfront to leisure use.

South of the river, change was more selective. The row of 12 houses on Main Road was left untouched, while the primary school was enlarged and acquired a sports field behind it. The most significant development, however, came on the southern edge, where the railway line, which had previously passed through without stopping, gained a station. The eastern half of the south-west forest was cleared to make room for a car park next to the new station, and a supermarket was built opposite the station.
why9: Overview with a characterisation
"from a quiet farming village into a sizeable, well-connected settlement" mô tả bản chất thay đổi bằng một cụm danh từ giàu thông tin, không chỉ nói "larger" (TA, LR).
Overview acknowledges continuity
"although the historic core along Main Road survived largely intact" cho thấy người viết cân nhắc cả cái thay đổi lẫn cái giữ nguyên, điều bài band 9 cần có với dạng bản đồ (TA).
Spatial grouping
Đoạn 1 mở bằng "north of the river", đoạn 2 mở bằng "South of the river". Chia theo vị trí giúp người đọc hình dung bản đồ và tạo mạch lạc tự nhiên (CC).
Hedged inference from the data
"suggesting a shift from working waterfront to leisure use" là suy luận nhẹ, có rào đón bằng "suggesting", hợp lý với dữ liệu (cảng cá thành bến du thuyền) mà không bịa thêm thông tin (TA, LR).
Varied passive and change verbs
"gave way to", "was redeveloped as", "was left untouched", "was enlarged", "was cleared to make room for" đa dạng mà chính xác cho từng loại thay đổi (LR, GRA).
Past perfect for earlier state
"which had previously passed through without stopping" dùng quá khứ hoàn thành để nói tình trạng trước khi có nhà ga, đúng logic thời gian (GRA).
t1a.band8vs9: Bài band 8 liệt kê đủ thay đổi theo vị trí nhưng tổng quan chỉ nói "larger, better-connected community". Bài band 9 xác định rõ tính chất của sự thay đổi (từ làng nông nghiệp yên tĩnh thành khu dân cư lớn, giao thông thuận tiện), nêu hai cụm thay đổi lớn và cả phần được giữ nguyên ngay trong tổng quan. Thân bài có câu chủ đề cho từng khu vực ("change was more selective") và một suy luận có rào đón về chức năng của bến sông. Động từ chỉ thay đổi đa dạng và chính xác hơn, ít lặp "was built".

t1g.prompt:
You recently ordered a laptop from an online shop, but when it arrived there were several problems with it. Write a letter to the customer services manager. In your letter
- give details of your order
- explain what was wrong with the laptop
- say what you would like the company to do
Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Sir or Madam,
t1g.model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about a laptop I ordered from your website on 3 May (order number 58214), which was delivered last Friday.

I chose your shop because the product page promised next-day delivery and a brand-new machine with a 15-inch screen and 16GB of memory. Unfortunately, the parcel arrived four days late, and the box had clearly been opened before. When I switched the laptop on, I discovered that it had only 8GB of memory and that the screen had a noticeable scratch across one corner. In addition, the charger was missing, so I have been unable to use the computer for more than an hour at a time.

As I need the laptop for my work, this situation has caused me considerable inconvenience. I would therefore like you to arrange for the faulty item to be collected from my home and replaced with the correct model as soon as possible. If this is not possible within one week, I would expect a full refund, including the delivery charge.

I look forward to your prompt reply.

Yours faithfully,
Daniel Hart
t1g.notes: Giọng trang trọng vì viết cho công ty, không biết tên người nhận nên mở bằng "Dear Sir or Madam," và kết bằng "Yours faithfully," + họ tên đầy đủ. Câu đầu nêu ngay mục đích (complain about...). Đoạn 1 xử lý ý 1: ngày đặt hàng, mã đơn, ngày giao. Đoạn 2 xử lý ý 2: liệt kê từng lỗi cụ thể (giao trễ, sai cấu hình, màn hình trầy, thiếu sạc) bằng các từ nối "Unfortunately", "In addition". Đoạn 3 xử lý ý 3: nêu hậu quả rồi đưa ra yêu cầu rõ ràng có thời hạn (đổi máy trong một tuần, nếu không thì hoàn tiền). Giọng kiên quyết nhưng lịch sự, không dùng từ cảm xúc quá mạnh.

Câu mở đầu chuẩn cho thư phàn nàn, nêu thẳng mục đích
The parcel had clearly been opened before
Mô tả bằng chứng cụ thể cho lỗi
Thêm một vấn đề nữa, trang trọng hơn "also"
This has caused me considerable inconvenience
Nêu hậu quả một cách lịch sự nhưng rõ ràng
I would therefore like you to...
Đưa ra yêu cầu sau khi đã trình bày lý do
I look forward to your prompt reply.
Câu kết trang trọng, ngụ ý mong được trả lời sớm
t1g.model9:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing about order number 58214, placed on your website on 3 May for a Veltra 15 laptop with 16GB of memory and a 1TB drive, for which I paid £849 including next-day delivery.

The laptop finally arrived five days later, in a box with a torn seal that had evidently been opened before. On setting it up, I found that it has only 8GB of memory, half the specification I paid for, and a scratch running across the bottom corner of the screen. The charger was also missing, so the machine has been unusable since its battery ran flat on the first evening.

Since I bought the laptop specifically for a work project that begins on 20 May, I would ask you to arrange for it to be collected and replaced with the correct, new model before that date. Should that not be possible, I would expect a full refund, including the delivery charge, which I paid for a service I did not receive.

I would appreciate confirmation of how you intend to resolve this within the next five working days.

Yours faithfully,
Daniel Hart
why9: Purpose and order details fused

Câu mở "I am writing about order number 58214, placed on your website on 3 May for..." vừa nêu mục đích vừa trả lời trọn ý 1 (mã đơn, ngày, sản phẩm, giá) trong một câu bằng cụm phân từ "placed on". Gọn và đầy đủ (TA, GRA).
Evidence-based complaint
"half the specification I paid for" và "a box with a torn seal that had evidently been opened before" nêu lỗi kèm bằng chứng cụ thể, khiến lời phàn nàn khó bác bỏ (TA, LR).
Consequence linked to the fault
"the machine has been unusable since its battery ran flat on the first evening" cho thấy hậu quả thật của việc thiếu sạc, thay vì chỉ liệt kê "the charger was missing" (TA, CC).
Firm but courteous register
"I would ask you to arrange for it to be collected" và "I would expect a full refund" kiên quyết mà không gay gắt, đúng giọng khi viết cho quản lý chăm sóc khách hàng (TA).
Inverted conditional
"Should that not be possible, I would expect..." là câu điều kiện đảo ngữ, trang trọng và rất tự nhiên trong thư khiếu nại (GRA).
Justified demand
"which I paid for a service I did not receive" giải thích vì sao đòi hoàn cả phí giao hàng, cho thấy lập luận chặt chẽ (TA, CC).
t1g.band8vs9: Bài band 8 rõ ràng và đủ ba ý nhưng phần chi tiết đơn hàng còn mỏng và yêu cầu chưa gắn với một mốc cụ thể. Bài band 9 có đủ thông tin đơn hàng (giá, cấu hình), mỗi lỗi đi kèm bằng chứng hoặc hậu quả, và yêu cầu đổi máy gắn với hạn chót có lý do (dự án bắt đầu ngày 20/5). Giọng văn kiên quyết nhưng lịch sự nhờ các cấu trúc như "I would ask you to" và đảo ngữ "Should that not be possible". Câu kết đặt thời hạn trả lời cụ thể thay vì câu xã giao chung chung.

t1g.prompt:
The park near your home has become unsafe to use in the evenings. Write a letter to your local council. In your letter
- describe the problems in the park
- explain how these problems affect local residents
- suggest what the council could do to improve the situation
Write at least 150 words. You do NOT need to write any addresses. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Sir or Madam,
t1g.model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing on behalf of residents of Elm Road to draw your attention to the condition of Westfield Park, which has become unsafe after dark.

Over the past year, several street lamps along the main path have stopped working and have not been repaired. As a result, the area near the children's playground is almost completely dark by six o'clock in winter. There is also more litter, including broken glass, and groups of teenagers often gather there late at night.

These problems have a direct impact on the local community. Many people who used to jog there after work now avoid it altogether. Parents no longer feel comfortable letting their children use the playground in the late afternoon, and elderly residents have told me that they are afraid to take a short cut through the park on their way home.

I would therefore like to request that the council repairs the lighting as a matter of urgency. In addition, it would be helpful if litter bins were emptied more often and if the park were included in regular evening patrols.

Yours faithfully,
Michael Turner
t1g.notes: Viết cho cơ quan nhà nước nên dùng giọng trang trọng, "Dear Sir or Madam," / "Yours faithfully,". Câu mở cho biết người viết đại diện cư dân và vấn đề chính. Đoạn 2 (ý 1) mô tả vấn đề cụ thể: đèn hỏng, khu vui chơi tối, rác và kính vỡ, nhóm thanh niên tụ tập. Đoạn 3 (ý 2) nêu ảnh hưởng tới từng nhóm người: người chạy bộ, phụ huynh, người già. Đoạn 4 (ý 3) đưa ra đề xuất bằng cấu trúc lịch sự "I would like to request that...", "it would be helpful if...". Lưu ý dùng giả định "if the park were included" để tăng điểm ngữ pháp.

why9: Representative, measured register
"I am writing on behalf of a number of residents of Elm Road to raise our concerns" vừa nêu tư cách đại diện vừa giữ giọng trang trọng, ôn hòa phù hợp khi viết cho hội đồng địa phương (TA).
Accountability detail
"despite several reports to your helpline" ngầm nhắc hội đồng đã được báo trước mà không cần buộc tội trực tiếp. Đây là cách gây áp lực lịch sự rất tinh tế (TA, LR).
Concrete description of problems
"in near-total darkness from early evening in winter" và "sometimes playing loud music until after midnight" cụ thể, đáng tin, không phóng đại (TA).
Effects organised by group
Đoạn 3 lần lượt nói đến người chạy bộ và dắt chó, phụ huynh, người lớn tuổi, mỗi nhóm có một hành vi thay đổi cụ thể ("now drive to another one across town"). Ý 2 được triển khai đầy đủ (TA, CC).
Collective 'we' for suggestions

"We would urge the council to..." và "which we believe would quickly restore residents' confidence" dùng "we" để nhấn mạnh đây là ý kiến của cộng đồng, và đề xuất được giải thích bằng kết quả mong đợi (TA, GRA).
Precise collocations
"out of order", "as a matter of priority", "restore residents' confidence" là collocation chuẩn của văn bản hành chính (LR).

Bài band 9 thêm chi tiết có sức nặng: số đèn hỏng, thời gian hỏng, đã báo hội đồng nhiều lần, và mỗi nhóm cư dân có hành vi cụ thể đã thay đổi. Dear Ms Collins,

I am writing to apologise sincerely for missing my interview for the position of Marketing Assistant, which was scheduled for 10 a.m. yesterday. I realise that this caused inconvenience to you and your colleagues, and I regret that I was not able to let you know in advance.

I remain very interested in the position and I believe my experience in social media campaigns would allow me to make a real contribution to your team. I would be extremely grateful if you could consider offering me another interview at a time that suits you. I am available on any day next week and can attend at short notice.

Thank you for your understanding.

Yours sincerely,

Dear Mrs Walsh,

I wanted to let you know in good time that we're about to have some building work done at number 14, and I'm afraid it's likely to be noisy at times.

The builders are due to start on Monday 12 June, and the job should take about five weeks. They'll only be working on weekdays, from 8.30 a.m. to 5 p.m., so evenings and weekends should be as peaceful as usual.

why9: Considerate, neighbourly opening

"I wanted to let you know in good time" và "I'm afraid it's likely to be noisy at times" vừa thông báo vừa xin thông cảm trước, giọng thân thiện vừa phải, đúng với một người hàng xóm không quá thân (TA).
Work described from the neighbour's viewpoint

"part of the rear wall, the one closest to your garden, will have to come down" và "drilling and a cement mixer running for the first couple of weeks" nói rõ điều gì sẽ ảnh hưởng đến bà Walsh và trong bao lâu (TA).
Reassurance built into the schedule

Concrete, tailored mitigation
"to save the noisiest work for late morning where possible" là biện pháp cụ thể, chu đáo, cho thấy người viết thật sự nghĩ cho hàng xóm (TA).
Open invitation to raise problems

Dear Jamie,

Thanks so much for your lovely letter and for inviting me to stay with you at the end of the month. I'd love to see your new flat, and the idea of walking along the coast together sounds amazing.

Dear Chris,

I was so excited to get your message saying you're finally coming to visit! It's been ages since we last saw each other, and I can't wait to show you around my city.

I've already started making a list of things we could do. On your first evening, I'll take you to the night market near the river, where you can try some of the street food I'm always telling you about. As for packing, it'll be hot and humid while you're here, so bring light clothes and plenty of sun cream. It also rains quite suddenly in the afternoons, so a small umbrella or a light raincoat would be a good idea. Don't forget comfortable shoes, as we'll be doing a lot of walking!

See you soon,
Linh

In many countries, the cost of a degree has risen so sharply that students graduate with debts that take decades to repay. This has led some to argue that the state should cover tuition fees for everyone. While I accept that higher education brings wide social benefits, I believe that making it completely free for all students is neither fair nor sustainable.

The strongest argument for free tuition is that it widens access. Talented young people from low-income families are often put off by the prospect of heavy loans, and a free system would allow them to compete on merit rather than wealth. Moreover, a highly educated workforce benefits the whole economy, since graduates tend to earn more, pay more tax and drive innovation. From this perspective, public funding is an investment rather than a cost.

However, a fully free system has serious drawbacks. Universities are expensive to run, and if the government pays every fee, the money must come from general taxation, including taxes paid by people who never attend university and often earn less than graduates. This effectively asks lower earners to subsidise the future careers of the middle class. In addition, when funding is limited, free systems frequently respond by capping student numbers or allowing teaching quality to decline, as overcrowded lecture halls in some European countries show.

A more balanced approach would be to combine generous grants for students from poorer backgrounds with income-linked loans for others, which are repaid only once graduates earn above a certain threshold. This protects access without placing the entire burden on taxpayers.

In conclusion, although the aim of free higher education is admirable, I disagree that it should be provided to all students. Targeted support is a fairer and more effective way to ensure that ability, not income, determines who goes to university.

Few policies sound as unambiguously generous as free university tuition, yet the word 'free' conceals rather than answers the real question, which is who ought to pay for a degree. My view is that the state should carry a substantial share of the cost, but that abolishing fees for every student would be both regressive and, in the long run, self-defeating.

The case for public funding is stronger than its critics often admit. A degree does not merely raise one graduate's income; it produces doctors, teachers and engineers whose work benefits people who never set foot on a campus. Where those wider returns exist, it is reasonable for taxpayers to contribute, and where talented school leavers from poorer homes are deterred by the prospect of debt, society loses ability it can ill afford to waste.

The difficulty lies in the word 'all'. Students from affluent families are heavily over-represented at university almost everywhere, so a universal subsidy channels public money disproportionately towards those who need it least, and it does so partly through the taxes of people who left school at sixteen. Moreover, when governments foot the entire bill, they tend to control costs by rationing places or by allowing funding per student to erode quietly, with the result that free systems can end up admitting fewer disadvantaged applicants, not more.

A fairer settlement would separate the question of access from that of price. Means-tested grants could cover both fees and living costs for students from low-income households, while others would repay a contribution only once their earnings passed a set threshold, so that a graduate who never benefits financially from the degree never pays. Such a scheme keeps the door open without asking a care worker to subsidise a future surgeon.

In short, higher education deserves generous public investment, but making it free for everyone is a blunt instrument that serves the comfortable at least as well as the deserving. Targeted support achieves the stated aim more honestly.

t2.model:
Many politicians respond to public concern about crime by promising tougher punishment, and longer prison terms are often presented as the obvious solution. Although I agree that serious offenders must be removed from society, I disagree that lengthening sentences is the most effective way to cut crime overall.

Admittedly, long sentences have some value. While dangerous criminals are behind bars, they cannot harm the public, and for violent or repeat offenders this protection is essential. Severe penalties also send a clear message that society takes certain crimes seriously, which may reassure victims and their families.

However, the evidence that longer sentences deter crime is weak. Most offenders do not calculate the length of a possible sentence before acting; they commit crimes impulsively, under the influence of drugs or alcohol, or because they believe they will not be caught. Research in criminology consistently suggests that the certainty of being caught matters far more than the severity of the punishment. Furthermore, prisons can make the problem worse. Inmates who spend years mixing with hardened criminals often leave with fewer job prospects and stronger criminal connections, so reoffending rates remain high.

For these reasons, resources would be better spent elsewhere. More visible policing increases the chance of arrest, while education and job-training programmes inside prisons help former inmates find legal work after release. Tackling root causes such as poverty, school dropout and addiction would also prevent many young people from turning to crime in the first place. Norway, for example, combines relatively short sentences with intensive rehabilitation and has one of the lowest reoffending rates in Europe.

In conclusion, while prison remains necessary for the most dangerous offenders, simply making sentences longer is not the best way to reduce crime. Prevention, effective policing and rehabilitation offer far greater long-term benefits.
